2921-3652-5006-8170.description:

Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Ornithopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

2486-4659-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4659-4694-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Repeat from step 1.

252-2079-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-2079-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

4681-5147-6542-7747.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Giant-Sized Flying Ant, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Giant-Sized Flying Ant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Repeat.

3490-5445-6797-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another artifact or creature
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat

222-527-3967-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3967-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

176-560-2292.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-560-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Queen Allenal of Ruadach.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

414-2486-4613.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
414-2486-4613.description:
Activate a creature using Grist's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to create a 1/1 Insect creature token and mill a card, and then put a loyalty counter on the creature and repeat the process if the card was an Insect.
The Insect enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef, causing it to have Grist's abilities.
Repeat from step 1 using the Insect token instead.

2173-2292-4446-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2173-2292-4446-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2425-3490-5231-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2425-3490-5231-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

198-3918-4824.description:
Activate Trazyn using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Trazyn using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1563-1849-2351-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-1849-2351-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

549-1365-4853-5315--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-4853-5315--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

1018-2103-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.

1018-2103-2665.description:

At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Skullwinder.
When the token Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1976-5078-5741.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

Sword of the Paruns attached to Leafkin Avenger
5200-5704.description:
Activate Leafkin Avenger by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Leafkin Avenger
Repeat.
5200-5704.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

1409-2167-5531.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three lands.
You control at least two mana-producing lands, one of which can produce {U}.
1409-2167-5531.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a mana-producing land, adding one mana of any type that land can produce.
Repeat step 1 at least two more times, and more times if desired, ensuring to leave at least one land on the battlefield.
Activate Lumra by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Lumra enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and then return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Lumra.
Repeat.

1339-2425-2438.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2425-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1479-2783-3861.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2783-3861.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it, Nesting Dragon, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Nesting Dragon trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

147-855-1638-2060.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Corpsejack Menace.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

1819-3457-3740-4684-4825-5006.notablePrerequisites: Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
1819-3457-3740-4684-4825-5006.description:
Tap Seeker of Skybreak to untap itself.
Mill 1 with Mesmeric Orb.
Repeat until you mill Nullpriest of Oblivion and Syr Konrad shuffling when you do not mill them using the Titan.
Cast and kick Nullpriest of Oblivion with Lurrus of the Dream-Den, bringing Syr Konrad to the battlefield.
Repeat Milling until you mill the Titan, dealing damage with Syr Konrad.

1953-2105-2959.description:
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Brudiclad triggers, creating a 2/1 Phyrexian Myr creature token, then choosing to have all tokens you control become copies of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare one of the Combat Celebrant copy as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks.
The Combat Celebrant copy triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.
